_note: Facts this repository asserts about software it does not contain.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. On 2026-09-08, within one hour: docs/RELEASE-v1.0.md
said stagecheck had 43 tests (it has 62); its pyproject.toml still said
version 0.1.0 after gaining relations, a CLI, a dashboard and three
provenance features; docs/TODO-provenance.md listed three gaps as
outstanding when all three were implemented; and the README's link pointed
at gitlab.com when the canonical remote was github.com.
Four facts about another package, written down here, never read back.
That is the same defect crosscheck exists to catch — a load-bearing fact
recorded once cannot be checked — except it crosses a repository boundary,
which crosscheck could not see past.
HOW A CLAIM IS CHECKED. Three ways at once:
1. is it TRUE of the package (read from a local clone, no network)
2. does every document in `cited_in` actually contain it
3. does any document contradict it with a different value
A claim that is true but absent from the docs is drift waiting to happen;
a claim in the docs that is not declared here cannot be checked at all.

stagecheck.why: the one tool from this study that is separately installable, so its facts travel further than anything else here

claims.note: read from pyproject.toml. Was 0.1.0 until 2026-09-08 — the version had not moved since the first scaffold while the package grew a CLI, a dashboard, relations and three provenance features.
the number quoted in the release notes. It said 43 until an hour before the tag, because nobody had run the suite from this side.
'no dependencies' is claimed in two places and is the reason the package is usable outside this study. If one is ever added, both sentences become false.
the README pointed at gitlab.com for days. A dead link on the one installable thing.
docs/TODO-provenance.md described this as unbuilt future work after it had shipped. Asserting the symbol exists keeps that file honest.
Ledger.merge() refuses to pool two ledgers whose run stamps disagree — the second of the three provenance gaps, and also shipped.
